units.source_text: “有时候，漂亮的姑娘穿素净些，反而更合适。

en.t: Sometimes, a pretty girl looks better dressed a little more plainly.

units.source_text: 不过……”母亲一边打开锅盖，用筷子夹了夹锅里的东西，一边说，

en.t: But...,” Mother said as she lifted the pot lid and prodded what was inside with her chopsticks,

units.source_text: “你爹为什么就不能画些鲜艳时兴的图案呢？”

en.t: why can’t your father paint some brighter, more fashionable designs?”
